title: Long-Standing Member Write-Off on Spent-Credit Card Charges
content:
Long-standing Marlowe Rewards members receive a write-off when spent instant store credit from a Returns & Exchanges Store Credit Return is charged to their original card. The write-off is taken off the amount charged.

## Write-off

| Cardholder's Marlowe Rewards membership | Write-off |
|---|---|
| Platinum, Icon or Atelier, in status active, enrolled at least 60 calendar months before today | 25.00 USD |
| Gold, in status active, enrolled at least 60 calendar months before today | 10.00 USD |
| Anyone else | Nothing |

The amount charged to the original card is never below zero, so a write-off larger than the amount leaves nothing to charge.

## Boundaries

| Membership | Enrolled | Write-off |
|---|---|---|
| Icon, active | Exactly 60 calendar months before today | 25.00 |
| Icon, active | 59 calendar months before today | Nothing |
| Gold, active | 72 calendar months before today | 10.00 |
| Silver, active | 120 calendar months before today | Nothing |
| Platinum, suspended | 80 calendar months before today | Nothing |

The tier, status and enrolment date are read from the Marlowe Rewards membership.

Example (hypothetical): an amount of 39.20 for an active Atelier member enrolled in the programme seven years ago becomes 14.20.
